releaseNotes: Restores strict Pen/Marker option separation that was unintentionally removed when 0.12.30 replaced the 0.12.29 combined patch
Pen mode shows only Pen-Art, Pen thickness and Pen colors
Marker mode shows only Marker colors, Marker thickness and opacity
The isolation is reapplied after every tool/color/thickness/style rerender on BOOX
Keeps the now-working 0.12.30 note deletion and hardware-confirmed fullscreen unchanged
